info.title: MaxAPI Midjourney API
info.description: Midjourney image generation, interaction, and task management. Authenticate with a MaxAPI Bearer API key. Examples use the /mj prefix; keep a consistent mode prefix for each task. Examples illustrate structure: use task IDs, action identifiers, and image content from your own requests.

servers.description: Fast: the default example uses /mj. Select a mode enabled for your account.
Turbo: produces /mj-turbo/mj/... paths and requires Turbo access for your account.
Relax: produces /mj-relax/mj/... paths and requires Relax access for your account.

BearerAuth.description: Create an API key in the console and send it as Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>.

instanceId.description: Select an account instance by ID. Set this only when you have a known, available instance ID.

modes.description: Filter account modes. This does not replace the mode prefix in the request URL.

remix.description: Filter by whether Remix is enabled on the account.

remixAutoConsidered.description: Whether account filtering treats Remix with automatic submission as remix being false.

AccountFilter.description: Optional account filters. Standard integrations can usually omit them and let the service select an available account.

ids.description: IDs of the tasks to retrieve. Match returned objects by id rather than relying on their array positions.

items.description: Task ID from result in a submission response or id in a fetched task. Keep it as a string.

code.description: Submission business code: 1 means submitted and 22 means queued. Interpret 21 with the endpoint and task state: an action can require modal confirmation (MODAL), while some compatible versions use it for an existing task. For other codes, read description instead of treating the generation as successful.

result.description: ID associated with this submission. Its presence alone does not mean that a failed submission should be polled.

properties.description: Additional submission metadata. Handle fields according to the actual response.

customId.description: Action identifier to pass unchanged to action.

label.description: Display label, not the action identifier.

style.description: Button style. The documented values include 2 for Primary and 3 for Green.

type.description: Button type, normally used by display components.

finalPrompt.description: Image descriptions from Describe or analysis from Shorten. The string may contain Markdown or multiple text sections.

finalZhPrompt.description: Optional Chinese translation. It may be absent.

action.description: Task type, such as IMAGINE, UPSCALE, VARIATION, REROLL, ZOOM, PAN, DESCRIBE, BLEND, or SHORTEN. Other types may be added by different versions.

status.description: Task state: NOT_START, SUBMITTED, MODAL (awaiting input), IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILURE, or CANCEL. MODAL requires a modal submission; polling alone does not resolve it. Handle unfamiliar values explicitly.

progress.description: Display progress, such as 100%. Use status to determine completion.

imageUrl.description: Image URL; during generation it may refer to a preview. Confirm SUCCESS before downloading the final image. For Describe and Shorten, also read text results from properties.

failReason.description: Failure reason, which may be null or absent when the task has not failed.

state.description: Application correlation value supplied when submitting.

buttons.description: Buttons returned for this task. Submit the selected customId together with the ID of the task it belongs to.

code.description: Business result code. Inspect description and the subsequent task state; HTTP 200 alone does not establish completion.
1 means the seed was retrieved. For other values, read description.

result.description: Image seed as a string. This is not a new task ID or an image URL.

ErrorResponse.description: Error bodies depend on the gateway or channel. Preserve the original response for troubleshooting without assuming a universal field structure.

pageSize.description: Items per page. The example is not a server default or maximum.

sort.description: Sort expression. Use only syntax confirmed for the current channel.

items.description: Task ID from result in a submission response or id in a fetched task. Keep it as a string.

state.description: Filter by the application correlation value.

empty.description: Whether the current page is empty.

first.description: Whether this is the first page.

last.description: Whether this is the last page.

numberOfElements.description: Actual number of items on the current page.
